name: Counties of Kenya
source: Constitution of Kenya 2010, First Schedule (Counties) [names]; IEBC, Registered Voters per County Assembly Ward for the 2022 General Election [codes]

name: Sub-counties of Kenya (KNBS 2019 census)
source: KNBS, 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census Volume I: Population by County and Sub-County, Table 2.5

name: Constituencies of Kenya (IEBC)
source: IEBC, Registered Voters per Constituency for the 2022 General Election

name: County Assembly Wards of Kenya (IEBC)
source: IEBC, Registered Voters per County Assembly Ward for the 2022 General Election

name: Posta Kenya post offices and postal codes
source: Postal Corporation of Kenya, "Locate a post office" store-locator data on posta.co.ke/post-offices

name: Kenyan banks (CBK-licensed commercial banks, mortgage finance institution, microfinance banks) with KEPSS/clearing bank code and SWIFT/BIC
source: Central Bank of Kenya: Directory of Licenced Commercial Banks, Mortgage Finance Institutions and Authorised Non-Operating Bank Holding Companies (July 2026 upload) + Directory of Licenced Microfinance Banks (Feb 2026); bank codes from Kenya Bankers Association Bank Branch Code list 2026; SWIFT from each bank's own website or CBK KEPSS Rules Schedule B

name: Kenyan bank branches with clearing (bank + branch) codes
source: Kenya Bankers Association: Bank Branch Code list 2026 (Branch-Code-2026.pdf, linked from kba.co.ke/bank-branch-code/)

name: CBK Authorised Payment Service Providers
source: Central Bank of Kenya - Directory of Authorized Payment Service Providers (PSPs) as at August 10, 2026

name: CBK Licensed Money Remittance Providers
source: Central Bank of Kenya - Directory of Licenced Money Remittance Providers (MRPs) as at September 30, 2026

name: CBK Licensed Credit Reference Bureaus
source: Central Bank of Kenya - Bank Supervision Annual Report 2025, Appendix XIX Directory of Credit Reference Bureaus (cross-checked against the Directory of Licensed CRBs, November 2022)

name: CBK Licensed Digital Credit Providers
source: Central Bank of Kenya - Directory of Digital Credit Providers, updated on September 29, 2026

name: CBK Licensed Foreign Exchange Bureaus
source: Central Bank of Kenya - Directory of Licenced Foreign Exchange Bureaus as at September 30, 2026

name: SASRA Licensed and Authorised SACCO Societies 2026
source: Sacco Societies Regulatory Authority - List of Licensed and Authorised Sacco Societies in Kenya for the Financial Year ending 31st December 2026 (dated 3 February 2026)

name: Capital Markets Authority (Kenya) licensees, approved institutions and approved schemes
source: Capital Markets Authority Kenya - Licensees/Market Players portal (licensees.cma.or.ke), all 20 category pages

name: Kenyan statutory bodies for HR, payroll, finance and compliance
source: Each institution's official website (verified by HTTP request on 2026-11-01); Affordable Housing Act 2024 on kenyalaw.org for the Affordable Housing Board

name: Kenyan mobile number prefixes (NDC allocations)
source: Communications Authority of Kenya - Telecommunication Numbering Plan for Kenya (CA/SRM/S&N/NNP/APRIL/2026), section 1.1(b)

name: Kenya public holidays 2026-2028
source: Kenya Law - Public Holidays Act (Cap. 110), revised 26 April 2024 (latest version); Kenya Gazette special issues on kenyalaw.org

name: ISO 4217 currency codes (List One, active)
source: SIX Financial Information (ISO 4217 Maintenance Agency) - ISO 4217 List One: Currency, fund and precious metal codes

name: Kenya National Qualifications Framework levels
source: Kenya Law - The Kenya National Qualifications Framework (General) Regulations, 2025 (L.N. 94 of 2025), First Schedule Part 4 (Minimum Entry Requirements table)

name: ISCO-08 occupation classification (used because KNOCS/KeSCO is not openly published)
source: International Labour Organization - ISCO-08 Structure and definitions (English)
